annotations.title: Get the rule on a date

description: Get the rule that was (or will be) in effect on a date, in the same shape as get_rule. Example: `{"rule_type": "minimum_wage", "jurisdiction": "us-wa", "as_of": "2025-06-30"}`. Use it to see what applied when a past decision was made. `page_url` is the rule's juriset.dev page for people, which lists every version. A date before Juriset's coverage of that jurisdiction is answered with an error that says where coverage starts. Informational only, not legal advice. If the API key's plan does not include as-of queries the error says so.

domain.description: The rule type's domain, e.g. `employment`. Optional: when omitted it is looked up from the rule type.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction slug from list_jurisdictions, e.g. `us-wa` (Washington), `us` (US federal), `ca-ab` (Alberta).

rule_type.description: Rule type slug from list_rule_types, e.g. `minimum_wage`, `overtime`.
